title: GabberPrincipalVanishingIdeal
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Write $F|_{D(a)}$ for inverse image along the open immersion $D(a)\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and use etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Assume that for every $f,g\in R$ and $x\in H^1(D(f+g),F|_{D(f+g)})$, if both pullbacks of $x$ along $D(f(f+g))\to D(f+g)$ and $D(g(f+g))\to D(f+g)$ vanish then $x=0$. Let $q>0$ and assume $H^n(D(a),F|_{D(a)})=0$ for every $a\in R$ and every $0<n<q$. Let $h\in R$ and $\xi\in H^q(D(h),F|_{D(h)})$. For $f\in R$ let $\rho_{h,f}^q:H^q(D(h),F|_{D(h)})\to H^q(D(fh),(D(fh)\to D(h))^{-1}(F|_{D(h)}))$ be the pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Then there is an ideal $I\subset R$ such that for every $f\in R$, $f\in I$ if and only if $\rho_{h,f}^q(\xi)=0$.

source.place: Lemma 0GY0 (label lemma-gabber-criterion), proof: simultaneous induction on all principal opens, local triviality, and the ideal of vanishing restrictions.

proof.text: Define the carrier I by rho_{h,f}(xi)=0. The zero element belongs since D(0) is empty and its cohomology is zero. Multiplication by r restricts further from D(fh) to D(rfh), so functoriality and inverse-image composition preserve zero. The empty-site sheaf is zero by Scheme.Etale.isZero_sheaf_of_isEmpty, and Sheaf.subsingleton_H_of_isZero gives zero membership. Functoriality followed by the inverse coefficient comparison proves zero preservation along composites.

source.place: Lemma 0GY0 (label lemma-gabber-criterion), proof: simultaneous induction on all principal opens, local triviality, and the ideal of vanishing restrictions.

proof.text: Set a=fh and b=gh. The class on D(h) restricts to D(a+b)=D((f+g)h). Transport it to F restricted to D(a+b) using upperStarComp. Both further restrictions to D(a(a+b)) and D(b(a+b)) vanish by functoriality because these opens lie in D(fh) and D(gh). In degree one apply hfg a b to this transported class. Reflect zero through the inverse coefficient isomorphism and restrict along the equality of the two sum opens.

source.place: Lemma 0GY0 (label lemma-gabber-criterion), proof: simultaneous induction on all principal opens, local triviality, and the ideal of vanishing restrictions.

proof.text: For q>1 write q=n+1 with 0<n<q. Apply principalOpenCohomology_joint_kernel to a=fh, b=gh and the same transported class. The intersection degree n group vanishes by hprev at a*b*(a+b). Reflect zero through the coefficient comparison. Define the ideal using the literal zero-restriction predicate, zero membership, addition closure, and left multiplication closure. The carrier equivalence is reflexivity.
